title: Record a check or cash payment

steps.caption: Clients
steps.narration: A client handed you a check. Here's how to record it against their invoice.

steps.caption: Search for the client
steps.narration: On Clients, search for the client.

steps.caption: Open the client
steps.narration: Click the name to open their page.

steps.caption: The invoice: paid and due
steps.narration: Under Invoices, this one is part paid. The line shows what's paid and what's still due.

steps.caption: Amount received
steps.narration: The amount is filled in with what's still due. Change it if the client paid less.

steps.caption: Method
steps.narration: Pick how they paid: check, cash, wire, or a card you took another way.

steps.caption: Note
steps.narration: Add a note, like the check number.

steps.caption: Paid, nothing due
steps.narration: The invoice is now marked paid, and the client gets an emailed receipt.

steps.caption: Outstanding balance
steps.narration: Higher up, the outstanding balance and the amount collected have changed too.

steps.caption: Listed under Payments
steps.narration: The payment is listed under Payments, with a Reverse button in case it was entered by mistake.

steps.caption: Menu: Clients
steps.narration: You'll find your clients, and their invoices, under Clients in the menu.

youtube.title: How to record a check or cash payment | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: A short walkthrough of recording a payment by hand in the ConstructHUB CRM. You will open a client, choose Record payment on their invoice, set the amount, the method and a note, and see the invoice and the client's balance update.
